description: Generate an SRT subtitle file from an audio or video URL using Whisper. Returns a pending job envelope immediately — poll with `get_transcribe` until status is `completed`, then fetch the signed SRT URL with `get_transcribe_download`. The SRT URL can be dropped directly into a transcode's `subtitles='<url>'` filter to burn captions into a video.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language hint (e.g. 'en', 'es'). Auto-detected when omitted.

media_url.description: Audio or video URL to transcribe. gs://bucket/object (preferred, from the upload flow) or a public https:// URL.

task.description: 'transcribe' keeps the source language; 'translate' outputs English regardless of source. Defaults to 'transcribe'.

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe Audio
